statements.impact_statement: The affected code (ory/x keysetpagination_v2 encrypted page tokens) is not present in this line: ory/x is pinned at v0.0.111 and client listing uses plain offset/limit queries with an integer offset passed to parameterized SQL.

jackc/pgproto3/v2 v2.3.3 is reachable through the PostgreSQL driver (pgx/v4). Exploitation requires the PostgreSQL server that Hydra connects to be malicious or compromised; Hydra connects only to the deployment's own configured database. No upstream v2 fix exists. Recorded as accepted risk, pending Security Lead and Engineering Lead approval and a Corporate Risk Registry entry (review within 90 days).
